mapper.select: SELECT * FROM sys_menu ORDER BY sort, id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_menu (menu_name, parent_id, menu_type, path, component, perms, icon, sort, visible, status) VALUES (#{menuName}, #{parentId}, #{menuType}, #{path}, #{component}, #{perms}, #{icon}, #{sort}, #{visible}, 1)
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_menu WHERE parent_id = #{parentId}

SELECT DISTINCT m.perms FROM sys_menu m INNER JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON m.id = rm.menu_id INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON rm.role_id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND m.perms IS NOT NULL AND m.perms != '' AND m.status = 1
